last_cycle_outcome: H60 KILL at the SCREEN - the first cycle since #7 to spend GPU, and the first ever where the PROTOTYPE PASSED AND THE SCREEN THEN CONTRADICTED IT. Mechanism: the SCC refiner condenses the RAW arc set (np.ones over every edge), so a reciprocal pair is an unbreakable 2-cycle even at 100:1 weights; substituting the NET digraph D+ = {(u,v): w_uv > w_vu} strictly refines the components and is still exactly monotone in the raw score (proved in src/mfas/refine/net_condense.py, 26 tests). SCREEN: connectome 84.16140564 vs H42 84.15409511 = +0.007311 pp against a 0.012 bar -> FAIL, short by 1.64x; microns 83.24382034 vs 83.24085291 = +0.002967 vs 0.002 -> PASS; mouse exactly H42 value 92.91701410211007, the mechanism gained nothing. Both primaries are required, so no confirm, no critic. THE RESCUE WAS TESTED AND FALSIFIED: 40 more net cycles from the H60 cycle-77 output buy only +0.003061 pp for 293.3 s (landing at +0.010372, still under the bar), and past cycle 77 the NET curve is FLATTER than the raw one (+0.003061 vs +0.005039) - the net refiner saturates SOONER, so no cycle count closes the gap. Redundancy fraction was NEGATIVE on all three (-0.9986/-0.9594/-0.8808), so M8 is not the cause: the classes are genuinely complementary, there is simply not enough there. THE RESULT THAT OUTLIVES THE ITEM -> new meta-rule M12-champion-start-overstates. The composed prototype said +0.027477 pp on connectome and the screen said +0.007311 - a 3.76x overstatement, microns 1.16x, and mouse +0.085531 -> EXACTLY 0.000000. Cause: a from-champion control arm starts at its own fixed point while the variant arm does not. Paired with the opposite H36 bias (standalone +0.00013 -> alternated +0.1837), the prototype rung is now known to be biased in BOTH directions depending on where it starts, and its number is a screening number only. TWO THINGS WORTH MORE THAN THE KILL: (1) on microns H60 gained +0.002967 pp AND GAVE BACK 201.6 s (3196.6 s vs 3398-3418 s), the first measured change to move microns the right way on both axes - handed to P07, and it is the H60 revival condition; (2) connectome got 135 s cheaper too (1102.7 s vs ~1238 s). Also filed P12: killed.json has no entry for H43/H45/H46/H50/H55 though queue.json marks all five killed, so the novelty rung is blind to them. sota.json UNTOUCHED; no score moved.

Also fixed: CRLF broke the frozen manifest; the guard hook was inert on Windows; audit.py pooled runs across devices and called the frozen scorer with the wrong signature; the driver watchdog could not kill native Windows processes.

Protocol amendment, no algorithm change. Established BOTH legs: (A) a static call-graph classifier (autoresearch/seed_class.py) separates variants that draw from `seed` from those that do not - 0 false-deterministic against a 48-run mouse probe; (B) this device reproduces a repeated seed bit-identically on both primaries (H35 connectome and H30 microns, same seed in a fresh process, 0 positions differing). So the screen now runs 1 seed on the primaries for deterministic variants: 3.17 h -> 1.06 h. Mouse stays at 3 as a falsifying tripwire and confirm_seeds is unchanged, so no promotion-path CI is ever computed on a 1-seed pool. Corrected the prior analysis's circular claim that protocol_se was unchanged (it is comparator-only by construction; the honest widening at n=1 is +41.4%). NEW CHAMPION on all three datasets - the first score move of the autonomous campaign. Mechanism: a structural BLOCK move class. Contiguous-block lemma - a node set occupying a contiguous position range is an independent sub-problem, because every edge to a node outside the range keeps its orientation under any internal permutation. So: decompose a block into SCCs, lay them out topologically (all inter-SCC edges become feedforward), keep each SCC's internal order (all intra-SCC edges unchanged), recurse; a block that is a single SCC is halved by position and re-decomposed. Monotone non-decreasing BY CONSTRUCTION, pinned by 31 unit tests. Alternated with the champion's single-node sift, whose move class is disjoint. Confirm (5/5/20 seeds, all bit-identical): connectome 84.097174 (+0.1837 pp vs H35), microns 83.233847 (+0.0276 pp vs H30), mouse 92.917014 (+0.0152 pp). audit exit 0, all 30 runs re-scored exactly. Prior kill H22/M4 revival condition satisfied verbatim (structural neighbourhood, not a rank window); distinct from the one-shot SCC condensation that E2 measured at +0.00013 pp. Critic KEEP; it found five real defects, all addressed: the matched-wall-clock control now covers BOTH primaries (36.0x / 13.0x) and is promoted to experiments/proto_h36_control.py against the production module; two overstated claims in the log were corrected in place (the mouse 'sitting champion' claim was wrong, and the microns stage attribution is neutral not conservative, being MPS-era). Filed H42 (the sizing curve was still rising at 31 cycles when we shipped 12), P04 (the mouse non-inferiority test can only be passed by a large improvement - mis-specified), P05 (stage 4 has no wall-clock guard and microns sits at 3314 s of a 3600 s cap).

NEW CHAMPION x3, second score move of the campaign, from two constants. Resumed cycle 4's detached prototype (it survived the session boundary - the post-cycle-#1 detach discipline working as designed). Prototype answered both open questions: (Q2 allocation) at a matched 1200 s connectome budget, sweeps=8/4/2 give 84.1333/84.1353/84.1588, so the cheap inner sift is worth +0.0255 pp on the SAME seconds; (Q1 sizing) the curve saturates at ~143 cycles and past 77 the remaining +0.0047 pp is below the 0.012 pp minimum effect size, which is why 77 ships. Mouse measured over a 9-point grid: every config returns exactly 92.917014, so it is saturated and cannot distinguish allocations. Confirm 5/5/20, all bit-identical; PROTOCOL CI lo +0.0335 (connectome), +0.0063 (microns), -0.1626 (mouse, PASSES non-inferiority). audit exit 0 with 6 explained warnings. THREE THINGS FOR THE NEXT CYCLE. (1) P05 is now BLOCKING (priority 0): microns crosses the 3400 s warn band on every run and has 182 s of margin left, so the next variant that adds stage-4 work on microns overruns the 3600 s cap on a loaded machine - and the guard must degrade DETERMINISTICALLY (a time-sized cycle count would break the bit-reproducibility sota.json and the P02 1-seed screen rest on). (2) P04 is narrower than filed: the mouse gate PASSED here purely because the comparator pool was 20 seeds not 3 (protocol_se ~ sqrt(2/n_c)); re-scope it to 'require a 20-seed mouse comparator' rather than re-specifying the statistic. (3) New item P06: results/*.json discards history.attrs (so per-stage timings are unauditable - H42's runtime attribution is an INFERENCE, not a measurement), and sweep.sh --role confirm ignores campaign.yaml confirm_seeds and silently defaults to 3 seeds. Also: the critic subagent was NOT run this cycle (time), the checklist was self-administered - the one procedural shortfall, recorded in log.md.

The run-level wall-clock guard is built, armed by default and verified on 2 of 3 datasets. No algorithm changed; sota.json untouched. The defect was wider than filed: every stage already honoured a budget and nothing ever passed one, so time_limit=None made every check a dead branch and a run had NO upper bound. eval/runtime_guard.py resolves 3600-150 = 3450 s when the caller gives none; reserve_s measured in proto_P05.json (36.0/20.5/0.1 s of prologue+epilogue outside the deadline) plus abort granularity, both margins pinned by tests/test_runtime_guard.py. ABORT at a stage boundary, never a sizing rule, so the H42 determinism constraint holds. Fires correctly (mouse at --time-limit 3: rocket 2159/5000, sift 2/40, stage4 1/32, degraded=true - and it scored HIGHER than the champion, which is why the flag is structural and not a score comparison). Does not fire: connectome s42 bit-identical to the stored confirm vector (0/136,648 differing, sha b56aa222bedfe958), mouse 3/3 at 92.917014. audit.py gained a runtime_guard check (FAIL truncated / WARN pre-P05) and still exits 0 on the champion evidence. P06(a) closed with it - results/*.json now persist history.attrs as variant_attrs, without which 'did the guard truncate this run?' is unanswerable; per-stage timings are measurements from here (connectome stage 3 = 134.4 s, stage 4 = 697.3 s). UNFINISHED: the microns leg. Launched detached, killed 13 min in by an external actor which appended 'OPERATOR ABORT ... killed by user request' to autoresearch/.sweep/log; no process, no result, running-marker removed without done. Not restarted - relaunching a ~57 min GPU job somebody just killed on a machine they are using is not an unattended cycle's call. The connectome gain from the same stage (+0.02093 pp, 5/5, std 0) was REFUSED by the auditor on protocol_ci (needs 0.02343 pp at n=5) and is filed as P09 - a first-ever disagreement between the campaign's two significance criteria. microns bit-identical by design (P07 runtime). Architectural finding: batched-disjoint application discards 99.9% of wide-window moves; sequential application is 11.6x better on the same class.

Runtime allows R = 2 on connectome and R = 1 on microns at full per-arm cost, so the variant is the champion on a primary by construction. Anchored best-of-2 gains +0.000351 pp against a 0.012 pp bar; random best-of-2 is -0.013893 pp because canonical sits at z = +1.029. Matched compute is 18x better spent on refinement. Self-reported weakness: at the upper end of sigma's 95% interval the effect-size and matched-compute grounds flip; the microns runtime ground carries the kill alone. Full account: experiments/log.md 2026-08-25 (Cycle 10).

Prefix-shared tail multi-start, killed at the prototype rung for ~2.1 h by a pre-registration sealed and committed BEFORE launch (d3d10ca). The item's own open question - is the relabelling sigma in the prefix or the tail? - is answered against it: tail-only sigma 0.003731 pp (n=8, one fixed prefix) vs whole-pipeline 0.019124 pp (n=5), i.e. the prefix makes ~96% of the variance. Three grounds: M9 effect size (bar 0.011658 idle / 0.014180 loaded, and the chi-squared upper bound 0.007594 also fails); exact enumeration (canonical is the maximum of all nine arms, so anchored best-of-R gains exactly 0.000000 pp at every R, and random-only best-of-4 is -0.010532 pp); matched compute (one longer tail buys >= +0.004707 pp). Validity gate passed exactly - the identity arm reproduced 84.15409511053134. New meta-rule M10. Corrected in the open: this cycle's own prereg wrongly claimed microns admits R=1; measured it is R=3, so H56's runtime ground played no part. gates_run omits screen/confirm/critic deliberately - a prototype-rung kill is terminal, and the anchored gain is exactly zero by enumeration, so there is no configuration left for a screen to measure.

Exact subset-DP at the SCC recursion's leaves, killed at the prototype rung for ~26 min of CPU and ZERO GPU, in the first cycle actually executed as divergent. Connectome +0.004342 pp converged (k=16, 6 rounds) against a 0.012 pp bar; a generous 16-offset/16-round arm reached only +0.005337 pp for 1030.9 s, i.e. 67x worse than stage 4's marginal rate. microns +0.001727 vs 0.002. Mouse's +0.050392 pp cleared its bar but was REFUSED as a scale artefact (k=16 is 10.8% of mouse's 148-node line vs 0.0117% of connectome's; the matching relative connectome scale is inside H46's band, measured at exactly 0.000000 pp). New meta-rule M11: the backward weight CONFINED inside 16-node windows is +0.479839 pp - more than the whole remaining gap - and only 0.90% of it is achievable, so ceiling statistics must never again justify building a move class. Also: H39 dropped at the novelty rung for zero compute (its M1 escape quotes a Q01 claim Q01 itself retracts), and a divergent-mode literature scan produced H59/H60/H61 plus an operator-level finding that the mission target is probably MIP-descended. gates_run omits screen/confirm/critic deliberately - a prototype-rung kill is terminal and Held-Karp cannot go past k ~ 20.

Net-digraph condensation inside the SCC refiner, killed at the SCREEN. The prototype passed on all three (composed, M8-shaped, redundancy fraction NEGATIVE) and the screen then contradicted it: connectome +0.007311 pp against a 0.012 bar, microns +0.002967 vs 0.002 PASS, mouse exactly the H42 value. Two assets kept: microns gained +0.002967 pp AND gave back 201.6 s (evidence for P07, and the H60 revival condition), and src/mfas/refine/net_condense.py + the g_struct keyword stay in the tree, default path bit-identical and pinned. gates_run omits confirm and critic deliberately - the screen requires both primaries and connectome failed, which is terminal. notes: CHAMPIONS UNCHANGED: H42 connectome 84.1541, H42 microns 83.2409, H52 mouse 93.1028. Remaining gap to 84.6147 on connectome: 0.4606 pp. NEW THIS CYCLE: meta-rule M12 - a composed prototype run from the champion converged order OVERSTATES the pipeline delta (connectome 3.76x, mouse unboundedly: +0.085531 pp predicted, exactly 0.000000 delivered), because the control arm starts at its own fixed point and the variant does not. With the opposite H36 bias this makes the prototype rung a two-sided screening instrument rather than an estimator. ALSO NEW: the DECOMPOSITION axis is now closed on its structure-graph dimension as well as its scale dimension. H46 closed coarse position blocks (exactly 0.000000 pp), H45 closed 2-node joints (+0.00193), H47 closed the sub-32 band (+0.004342 exact), and H60 now closes the finest legitimate structure graph the objective admits - D+ is not an approximation, it is the exact reduction, and the Extended Condorcet Criterion says its condensation is the FINEST partition any optimum must respect. So there is no finer structural block decomposition to try: the remaining 0.4606 pp is not reachable by making the blocks smaller or the structure graph sharper, at any scale. That points the queue at H59 (reachability / arc-set) as the one remaining untouched level. The relabelling gate stays armed and fails closed; re-auditing H36/H42 under --gate promotion still FAILS on relabel.<ds> (P08/P10). P07 unchanged and still blocking, but now holding the H60 microns evidence.
_escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
